Usage: tool repo add <path> [flags]

Register a repository by its path.

Arguments:
  <path>             Directory of the checkout to register.

Flags:
      --name=NAME    Name to register it under.
      --role=ROLE    What the repository is for (default: tool; one of: tool, lib, notes; env: $CLIKIT_TEST_ROLE).

Inherited flags:
  -h, --help         Show context-sensitive help.
      --json         Print one JSON object instead of text.
      --home=HOME    Root of the registry (default: ~/.local/state/tool; env: $CLIKIT_TEST_HOME).

Output:
  --json prints one object; text otherwise.

Examples:
  tool repo add ~/dev/gwt --role tool

Exit codes:
  0    success
  1    failed
  2    invalid arguments; nothing was run
  5    done, but some repositories need attention
